description:
Dear Sir/Madam,
We are pleased to invite your esteemed organization to participate in the Nordic Region’s only and exclusive Expo on Policing, Defence, Homeland Security, Forensics, Drones & Anti-Drone Systems –2nd Homeland Security Expo – 2026, scheduled on 3rd – 4th December 2026 at Kistamässan Exhibition & Congress Centre, Stockholm, Sweden.
The 1st edition was well attended by 50+ exhibitors and 1000+ delegates, including senior officials from Nordic Police Forces, Armed Forces, and business delegates. As the region’s only dedicated platform for Police, Central Armed Forces & Homeland Security, it attracted strong participation from stakeholders and force representatives, especially in view of current internal and external security challenges.
Homeland Security Expo 2026 not only highlights Sweden’s commitment to enhancing its defence infrastructure but also emphasizes the Nordic region’s role as a key player in the international defence landscape. By integrating state-of-the-art technology and fostering multinational partnerships, Sweden and its Nordic counterparts are better equipped to handle contemporary security challenges and contribute to global stability.
This exhibition is dedicated to the Nordic region's Army, Police, and allied forces, covering a wide range of segments including:
•	Defence & Homeland Security
•	Forensics, Drone & Counter-Drone Systems
•	Cyber Security & Surveillance
•	Armoured & Special Purpose Vehicles
•	Communication, Protection & Investigation Technologies
•	Fire, Disaster & Rescue Management
•	Force Wellness & Fitness
•	Training, Traffic & Logistics Solutions
•	Modern Equipment & Advanced Technologies

The expo brings together everything required by Police, Military, and Security Agencies for both daily operations and specialized missions, ensuring enhanced safety and protection of society.

We look forward to your participation at this prestigious event. 

Should you need any further information or clarification, please feel free
